englishDialogue: I poured you a glass of cold water, do you want it?
ilokanoDialogue: Nangbukbokak ti nalamiis a danum, kayatmo?
cebuanoDialogue: Naghuwad ko og bugnaw nga tubig, gusto ka?
situationText: Do you want the water? Accept it!

distractors.feedback: You must be very thirsty! Let's accept their kind offer instead of saying no.
It's a simple question about water, no need to say you don't understand!

npcDescription: A kind, elderly woman wearing a simple traditional dress, holding out a clear glass of cold water.

englishDialogue: We are playing basketball at the court, want to join?
ilokanoDialogue: Agy-ayam kami ti basketball idiay court, kayatmo ti sumali?
cebuanoDialogue: Nagdula mi og basketball sa court, gusto ka moapil?
situationText: Do you want to play? Accept the invite!

distractors.feedback: Saying goodbye means you don't want to play!
You love basketball, so let's excitedly accept their invitation instead of saying no!

npcDescription: A young, energetic teenage boy wearing a sweaty basketball jersey and holding a worn-out basketball.

englishDialogue: Do you want me to put extra sauce on this?
ilokanoDialogue: Kayatmo nga ikkak ti adu a sarsa daytoy?
cebuanoDialogue: Gusto ka butangan nako og extra sauce kani?
situationText: Do you want the sauce? Accept it!
englishFeedback: Here is your extra sauce. Enjoy!
ilokanoFeedback: Daytoy ti extra sarsam. Naimbag a pannangan!
cebuanoFeedback: Dia ra ang imong extra sauce. Kaon og maayo!

distractors.feedback: You love the sauce! Don't reject it.
They are asking you a Yes or No question, not giving you instructions to understand.

npcDescription: A cheerful, middle-aged street food vendor wearing an apron, holding a plastic squeeze bottle of sauce.

englishDialogue: I can make this extra spicy for you, is that okay?
ilokanoDialogue: Mabalin ko a pagbalinen a naanghang daytoy, okay lang?
cebuanoDialogue: Pwede nako ni himuong halang kaayo, okay ra?
situationText: You hate spicy food! Refuse it!
englishFeedback: Got it, no spice for you!

distractors.feedback: Remember, you hate spicy food! It's perfectly fine to say no here.
If you say 'okay', they will make it spicy! Say no instead.

npcDescription: A friendly cook in a casual uniform, holding a small bowl of bright red chili oil.

englishDialogue: Excuse me, did you drop this wallet?
ilokanoDialogue: Dispensarennak, natnagmo kadi daytoy a pitaka?
cebuanoDialogue: Tabi, nahulog ba nimo kining pitaka?
situationText: It's not your wallet! Refuse it!
englishFeedback: Ah, I'll keep looking for the owner then.
cebuanoFeedback: Ah, mangita na lang ko sa tag-iya.

distractors.feedback: Since the wallet isn't yours, let's politely say no.
They just want to know if it's yours, you just need to say no.

npcDescription: An honest-looking young woman carrying a shoulder bag, holding out a black leather wallet.

englishDialogue: Are you tired? Do you want to go home?
ilokanoDialogue: Nabayag kan? Kayatmon ti agawid?
cebuanoDialogue: Gikapoy ka? Gusto na ka muuli?
situationText: You are not tired! Refuse to go home!

distractors.feedback: You still have lots of energy! Let's tell them no so you can stay longer.
Saying 'okay' means you'll go home. Let's say no so you can keep hanging out!

npcDescription: A tired-looking friend in casual clothes, carrying a backpack and looking ready to go home.

englishDialogue: I don't have exact change, can I give you 3 pieces of candy instead?
ilokanoDialogue: Awan ti barya, mabalin a 3 a kendi ti isuklik?
cebuanoDialogue: Wala koy sinsiyo, pwede ba 3 ka kendi na lang ang isukli nako?
situationText: Candy sounds good! Agree to it!
englishFeedback: Thank you! Here is your candy.

distractors.feedback: Since you don't mind getting candy, it's perfectly fine to accept it!
It's a common practice at stores. You just need to accept the alternative.

npcDescription: A busy sari-sari store owner, an older man in a polo shirt, holding out three colorful wrapped candies.

englishDialogue: Can we meet at 5:00 PM instead of 4:00 PM?
ilokanoDialogue: Mabalin kadi nga agkikitata ti 5:00 PM imbes a 4:00 PM?
cebuanoDialogue: Pwede ba magkita ta inig ka 5:00 PM imbes 4:00 PM?
situationText: 5:00 is fine! Agree to the time!

distractors.feedback: You have the whole afternoon free, so there's no reason to decline!
They just asked to change the time. You should just say it's okay.

npcDescription: A busy classmate in neat clothes, holding a planner and checking their watch.

englishDialogue: Can you please clean your room before dinner?
ilokanoDialogue: Mabalin kadi a dalusam ti kwartom sakbay a mangan?
cebuanoDialogue: Palihug limpyuhi ang imong kwarto sa dili pa mangaon.
situationText: You will do it! Agree to clean up!

distractors.feedback: Since you already agreed in your head to clean the room, you should accept the request.
Saying 'okay' is a more natural way to agree to a chore than 'I understand'.

npcDescription: A caring mother wearing casual house clothes, with her hands resting confidently on her hips.

englishDialogue: Those are the rules of the game, got it?
ilokanoDialogue: Dagitoy ti pagalagadan ti ay-ayam, naawatam?
cebuanoDialogue: Mao na ang mga rules sa dula, nasabtan nimo?
situationText: You know the rules now! Tell them you understand!
cebuanoFeedback: Nindot, sugdan na nato ang dula!

distractors.feedback: You listened carefully and know the rules, so don't say you don't understand!
Saying no means you didn't get the rules.

npcDescription: An excited kid wearing shorts and a t-shirt, pointing eagerly downwards with one hand.

englishDialogue: Just turn left at the big church to get to the market.
ilokanoDialogue: Agliko ka laeng iti kannigid idiay dakkel a simbaan tapno makadanon ka idiay palengke.
cebuanoDialogue: Liko lang sa wala didto sa dako nga simbahan para makaabot sa palengke.
situationText: You know where to go! Tell them you understand!
englishFeedback: Safe travels, you won't get lost!

distractors.feedback: The directions were clear, so you should tell them you understand!
Saying no is dismissive. You should confirm that you understood the directions.

npcDescription: A helpful local tricycle driver wearing a cap and a towel over his shoulder, gesturing with his hand.

englishDialogue: The store will be closed tomorrow for the holiday.
ilokanoDialogue: Serrado ti tiendaan inton bigat gapu iti piesta.
cebuanoDialogue: Sirado ang tindahan ugma tungod sa holiday.
situationText: The store is closed! Tell them you understand!
englishFeedback: See you the day after tomorrow then!

distractors.feedback: They are just giving you a fact. Saying 'no' doesn't make sense here.
You should let them know that you fully understood the notice.

npcDescription: A polite store clerk in a uniform, holding up a small 'closed' sign.

englishDialogue: [Speaks very fast in a language you haven't learned yet]
ilokanoDialogue: [Agisasao iti napartak iti pagsasao a dimo pay nasursuro]
cebuanoDialogue: [Magsulti og paspas sa lengguwahe nga wala pa nimo nakat-uni]
situationText: They speak too fast! Tell them you don't understand!
englishFeedback: Oh, sorry! Let me find someone to translate.
cebuanoFeedback: Ay, pasayloa ko! Mangita kog mutranslate.

distractors.feedback: You have no idea what they said, so you definitely don't understand!
Never say yes if you don't know what you are agreeing to!

npcDescription: A lost foreign tourist with a big backpack, speaking rapidly and looking confused.

englishDialogue: So you carry the 1, divide by X, and find the square root...
ilokanoDialogue: Isunga itugotmo ti 1, imbingaymo ti X, ket birokem ti square root...
cebuanoDialogue: Busa dad-a ang 1, bahina sa X, ug pangitaa ang square root...
situationText: Math is too hard! Tell them you don't understand!
englishFeedback: That's okay, let's take it step by step again.

distractors.feedback: You are completely lost, you shouldn't lie and say you understand!
Saying 'okay' won't help you learn the math problem.

npcDescription: A patient teacher holding an open notebook full of math equations, pointing at the page.

englishDialogue: Go left, then right, then left, then behind the blue house...
ilokanoDialogue: Agliko ka iti kannigid, kalpasanna kannawan, sa kannigid, idiay likod ti asul a balay...
cebuanoDialogue: Liko sa wala, unya tuo, unya wala, unya sa luyo sa blue nga balay...
situationText: You are lost! Tell them you don't understand!
englishFeedback: Let me draw you a map instead.
cebuanoFeedback: Mag-drawing na lang kog mapa para nimo.

distractors.feedback: The directions were way too confusing, you should admit that you don't understand.
If you say yes, they will let you leave and you will get lost!

npcDescription: A fast-talking local resident pointing in five different directions at once with their fingers.

englishDialogue: Breakfast is ready!
ilokanoDialogue: Nakasagana ti pammigat!
cebuanoDialogue: Luto na ang pamahaw!
situationText: [RECALL] Breakfast time! Greet them for the morning!

distractors.feedback: You just woke up, it's not evening!
Greet them good morning first before thanking them for the food.

npcDescription: A smiling grandmother wearing a morning duster, holding a wooden cooking spatula.

englishDialogue: Wow, it's so hot today, right?
ilokanoDialogue: Wow, napudot unay ita, di ba?
cebuanoDialogue: Wow, inita karon, diba?
situationText: [RECALL] It's after lunch! Greet them for the afternoon!
englishFeedback: Good afternoon! Yeah, let's get some shade.
ilokanoFeedback: Naimbag a malem! Wen, inkan aglinong.
cebuanoFeedback: Maayong hapon! Oo, mangita tag landong.

distractors.feedback: It is already afternoon, not morning!
Don't say goodbye, you just saw them.

npcDescription: A friend carrying a basket of fresh vegetables, sweating slightly from the afternoon heat.

englishDialogue: Time to go home and rest.
ilokanoDialogue: Oras a mapan agawid ken aginana.
cebuanoDialogue: Oras na muuli ug mupahuway.
situationText: [RECALL] The sun is setting! Greet them for the evening!
englishFeedback: Good evening! Have a good rest.
ilokanoFeedback: Naimbag a rabii! Aginana ka iti nasayaat.

distractors.feedback: The sun went down, it's not afternoon anymore.
It's nighttime, not morning!

npcDescription: A tired but smiling street vendor, holding a folded-up rain umbrella.

englishDialogue: [Smiles and waves at you]
ilokanoDialogue: [Immisem ken nagkaway kaniam]
cebuanoDialogue: [Nipahiyom ug nikaway nimo]
situationText: [RECALL] Someone waves! Say a simple hello!

distractors.feedback: You are just saying hi, not leaving!
You don't need to excuse yourself, just be friendly.

npcDescription: An acquaintance wearing casual clothes, raising one hand to wave casually.

englishDialogue: Oh my, look how much you've grown!
ilokanoDialogue: Apo, kitaem no kasano ti idadakkelmo!
cebuanoDialogue: Hala, tan-awa ra gud unsa naka kadako!
situationText: [RECALL] You see your uncle! Ask about him well-being!
englishFeedback: I'm doing great, how about you?

distractors.feedback: Ask them how they are first, before answering!
You just arrived! Too early to say goodbye.

npcDescription: An older aunt or uncle with a big, welcoming smile, wearing nice clothes for your visit.

englishDialogue: You look happy! How have you been?
ilokanoDialogue: Kasla naragsakka! Kumusta ti biag?
cebuanoDialogue: Mura lag malipayon ka! Kumusta naka?
situationText: [RECALL] You are happy! Tell them you are doing well!

distractors.feedback: They already asked you! Now you answer.
You are feeling great, why would you apologize?

npcDescription: A close friend looking at you with a warm, relaxed expression.

englishDialogue: See you tomorrow! Take care.
ilokanoDialogue: Agkitata inton bigat! Agaluad ka.
cebuanoDialogue: Magkita ta ugma! Pag-amping.
situationText: [RECALL] Time to go home! Bid them farewell!

distractors.feedback: You are leaving work, not arriving! Say goodbye.
You aren't trying to pass by them, you are leaving.

npcDescription: A friendly coworker waving goodbye while still wearing their work uniform.

englishDialogue: It was so nice talking to you.
ilokanoDialogue: Naimbag a naka-sao ka.
cebuanoDialogue: Nindot kaayo nga naka-istorya tika.
situationText: [RECALL] You had a nice talk! Wish them a good day!

distractors.feedback: It might not be morning right now!
It might not be night right now!

npcDescription: A polite stranger wearing everyday clothes, smiling kindly while waving goodbye.

englishDialogue: Here is your order, careful it's hot!
ilokanoDialogue: Daytoy ti order-mo, agannad ka ta napudot!
cebuanoDialogue: Dia ra imong order, amping kay init!
situationText: [RECALL] You got your food! Thank the vendor!

distractors.feedback: You already know them, just thank them for the food!
You just bought food, you don't need to apologize!

npcDescription: A hard-working street food vendor handing over a hot paper bag of fresh street food.

englishDialogue: Happy birthday! Open it!
ilokanoDialogue: Narabas a panagkasangay! Luktam!
cebuanoDialogue: Malipayong adlawng natawhan! Ablihi!
situationText: [RECALL] A big gift! Show big gratitude!

distractors.feedback: Why are you apologizing? You just got a gift!
Saying hello is friendly, but right now we want to thank them for the amazing gift!

npcDescription: An excited friend holding out a beautifully wrapped gift box with a big ribbon.

englishDialogue: Phew, that was heavy. You're safe now.
ilokanoDialogue: Nagsaem daydiay a. Sige, natalged kan.
cebuanoDialogue: Kapoya ato uy. Sige, luwas naka.
situationText: [RECALL] They pushed your car! Thank them for helping!

distractors.feedback: Don't just greet them, they just did hard labor for you!
You say excuse me to pass by, not when someone saves your car!

npcDescription: A sweaty, helpful stranger wearing dirty clothes, wiping their forehead with a small towel.

englishDialogue: Hey! Watch where you're going!
ilokanoDialogue: Hoy! Kitaem ti pagnaanmo!
cebuanoDialogue: Hoy! Tan-awa imong gina-agian!
situationText: [RECALL] Oops, you bumped someone! Apologize!
englishFeedback: Just be more careful next time.

distractors.feedback: Saying 'Excuse me' isn't enough when you crash into them. Apologize!
You bumped into them! Why would you thank them?

npcDescription: A startled person holding a stack of disorganized papers, looking surprised.

englishDialogue: [Standing right in front of the door]
ilokanoDialogue: [Nakapatakder idiay sanga ti ridaw]
cebuanoDialogue: [Nagtindog dapit sa pultahan]
situationText: [RECALL] They are blocking the door! Ask to pass!

distractors.feedback: You didn't bump into them yet! Try asking them politely to move.
Saying 'Good morning' won't tell them you need to squeeze past!

npcDescription: A passenger wearing a backpack on their front, looking slightly annoyed.
